text: Now came the documents that mattered. The key letter was written by Lieutenant General Sir Archibald Nye, Vice Chief of the Imperial General Staff, to General Sir Harold Alexander, who commanded the Allied armies in Tunisia. After several drafts failed to sound natural, Nye was asked to write it himself.
